title: Partner/repository outreach + pilot shortlist
context: Under Hee-Lee Oss's 'delivered, not merged' standard, a lesson plan is a good deed only when a real teacher teaches it or a real repository accepts it for reuse — not when it is merely authored. No partner classroom, teacher network, or OER repository has yet agreed to accept and use these plans. This task opens the first partner-outreach threads — identifying candidate teachers, school curriculum leads, and OER repositories, making initial contact, and producing a prioritized shortlist — so that by M1 there is at least one confirmed adopting partner (task-013). Without this outreach, plans risk being authored but never adopted, which does not satisfy the project's success bar.
objective: Research and contact candidate adopting partners (teachers, schools, OER repositories) and produce a committed pilot shortlist with contact status and adoption mechanism for each candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 5 candidate partner types are researched and documented: individual teachers or teacher cohorts, school/district curriculum leads, OER repositories (e.g. OER Commons, Curriki, OpenStax Community, state OER hubs), and informal educator networks.
At least 3 outreach contacts are initiated (email, forum post, repository submission inquiry, or equivalent) and documented with date, channel, and content summary.
A committed pilot shortlist document ranks candidates by: likelihood of adoption, alignment with the project's subject/grade focus, and ability to provide structured feedback.
For each candidate, the document records: name/org, contact channel, adoption mechanism (classroom use vs. repository submission), current outreach status, and next action.
The shortlist explicitly notes which candidates could flip affected tasks to verifiedNeed: true and sets requestor once confirmed.
Document is committed to the repo; no PII of private individuals is committed without their consent.
resources: PLAN.md — §Open questions (Q2: partner-first vs. repository-first cold-start)
output: A committed partner-outreach and pilot-shortlist document covering at least 5 candidate types, at least 3 initiated contacts, ranked candidates with contact status and next actions, and a record of which candidates could confirm verifiedNeed.
